name: Hooded Lantern
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Burns Oil for Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light an additional 30 feet. Bonus Action: lower hood to Dim Light 5 feet or raise it again.

authored_operations: Burns Oil for Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light an additional 30 feet. Bonus Action: lower hood to Dim Light 5 feet or raise it again.

definition.name: Hooded Lantern
definition.description: A Hooded Lantern burns one flask of oil for 6 hours, casting Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map Bonus Action ignition/hood controls, cumulative fuel, extinguish/rekindle, cone/radius light and Torch attack through actual room/combat hosts. Retained light_source fields are incomplete rules.
